course_name: 室內設計施工材料與工法
outline:
作為施工圖的教學基礎，本課程介紹室內設計產業常用的構造材料與方法。
Prior to the training of professional work drawing, the course introduces most frequently used construction materials and methods in the Interior Design profession.
